jp: 骨を模して作られた矛。ボーン製ではない。噛み噛みすることでストレスを解消したり、おやつとして食べることができる。武器としては戦斧のような使い方になる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～
jp_grezzo: "骨を模して作られた矛。ボーン製ではない。噛み噛みすることでストレスを解消したり、おやつとして食べることができる。武器としては戦斧のような使い方になる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～"
en: Spears made in the shape of a bone. Not made of bone. It can be chewed to relieve stress or eaten as a snack. As a weapon, it is used like a battle axe. \n#~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Spears made in the shape of a bone. Not made of bone. It can be chewed to relieve stress or eaten as a snack. As a weapon, it is used like a battle axe. \n#~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una picca fatta a somiglianza di un osso. Di osso, però, non è. A morderla e rimorderla si scarica lo stress, e volendo si mangia come merenda. Come arma, si usa nel modo dell'ascia da battaglia. \n#~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t邪を祓う為に更に強大な邪を用いる、という考えから生み出された黒の剣。これには分身ともいうべく剣が世界を越えて複数存在し、それぞれ姿や能力が微妙に異なるという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t邪を祓う為に更に強大な邪を用いる、という考えから生み出された黒の剣。これには分身ともいうべく剣が世界を越えて複数存在し、それぞれ姿や能力が微妙に異なるという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A black sword, surrounded with an aura of dread, was created from the idea of using an even more powerful evil to exorcise evil. There are multiple alter egos of this sword across the world, each with slightly different appearances and abilities. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A black sword, surrounded with an aura of dread, was created from the idea of using an even more powerful evil to exorcise evil. There are multiple alter egos of this sword across the world, each with slightly different appearances and abilities. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una spada nera, nata dall'idea di usare un male ancora più grande per scacciare il male. Ne esistono più d'una, oltre i confini del mondo, che si potrebbero dire suoi sdoppiamenti: ognuna ha forma e poteri appena diversi. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t自由と独立を象徴する伝説の竹槍。ふさわしき者が手にすれば、ニンジャを一突きで殺すどころか、爆撃機すらも撃墜し、神をも殺せるという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t自由と独立を象徴する伝説の竹槍。ふさわしき者が手にすれば、ニンジャを一突きで殺すどころか、爆撃機すらも撃墜し、神をも殺せるという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Legendary bamboo spear symbolizing freedom and independence. It is said to slay a ninja with a single thrust, but also to shoot down bombers and killing Gods. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Legendary bamboo spear symbolizing freedom and independence. It is said to slay a ninja with a single thrust, but also to shoot down bombers and killing Gods. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: La leggendaria lancia di bambù che è il simbolo di libertà e indipendenza. Dicono che, in mano a chi la merita, non solo uccide un ninja con un colpo solo, ma abbatte perfino i bombardieri e riesce ad ammazzare anche un dio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tカルパの針。カルパとはひとつの世界が誕生し消滅するまでの時間。膨大な時の流れが刃の表面を伝っている。神力を込めて振るえば時空を切り裂くことが可能であり、移動手段にも使われている。\n#～叡智の書～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tカルパの針。カルパとはひとつの世界が誕生し消滅するまでの時間。膨大な時の流れが刃の表面を伝っている。神力を込めて振るえば時空を切り裂くことが可能であり、移動手段にも使われている。\n#～叡智の書～\n"
en: Kalpa hands. Kalpa is the time it takes for a world to come into being and cease to exist. An enormous flow of time runs through the surface of the blade. If wielded with divine power, it can cut through time and space, and is also used as a means of transportation. \n# ~Book of Wisdom~
en_grezzo: "Kalpa hands. Kalpa is the time it takes for a world to come into being and cease to exist. An enormous flow of time runs through the surface of the blade. If wielded with divine power, it can cut through time and space, and is also used as a means of transportation. \n# ~Book of Wisdom~"
it: La Mano del Kalpa. Il kalpa è il tempo che passa dalla nascita di un mondo alla sua fine. Sulla superficie della lama scorre un flusso di tempo smisurato. Chi la impugna caricandola di forza divina può squarciare lo spazio e il tempo, e c'è chi se ne serve anche per spostarsi. \n# ~Il Libro della Sapienza~

jp: \t\t柄のような形の杏仁豆腐に、細長くて発光して貫通力のある杏仁豆腐を着けた杏仁豆腐。切れ味はライトセーバーにやや劣る。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t柄のような形の杏仁豆腐に、細長くて発光して貫通力のある杏仁豆腐を着けた杏仁豆腐。切れ味はライトセーバーにやや劣る。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A long, thin, luminescent, penetrating Tofu attached to an Annin shaped like a handle. The sharpness is somewhat inferior to that of a lightsaber. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A long, thin, luminescent, penetrating Tofu attached to an Annin shaped like a handle. The sharpness is somewhat inferior to that of a lightsaber. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un budino di mandorle: a un budino di mandorle a forma d'elsa ne è attaccato un altro, lungo, sottile, luminoso e capace di trapassare. Taglia un po' meno di una spada laser. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tカニが自らのハサミに似せて作りだした巨大な第三の手。捕食した生物の殻と擬似筋肉で構成されており、神経接続によって動かすらしい。カニのハサミのようでカニのハサミでない存在。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tカニが自らのハサミに似せて作りだした巨大な第三の手。捕食した生物の殻と擬似筋肉で構成されており、神経接続によって動かすらしい。カニのハサミのようでカニのハサミでない存在。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A giant third hand created by the crab to resemble its own scissors. It is composed of the shells and pseudo-muscles of its prey, and seems to be moved through a neural connection. It looks like a crab's scissors, but it is not the crab's scissors. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A giant third hand created by the crab to resemble its own scissors. It is composed of the shells and pseudo-muscles of its prey, and seems to be moved through a neural connection. It looks like a crab's scissors, but it is not the crab's scissors. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una terza mano gigantesca che il granchio si è fatta a somiglianza della propria chela. È composta dai gusci delle creature che ha divorato e da muscoli finti, e pare che la muova con un innesto nervoso. Una cosa che sembra una chela di granchio e non è una chela di granchio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t忍者の一流派に伝わる、特殊な飛苦無。手に入れるには吹雪の山中で試練を突破する必要があるらしい。まとめて投げる分当たりやすいが、かさばって重い。当たった者のＳＰを奪う力がある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t忍者の一流派に伝わる、特殊な飛苦無。手に入れるには吹雪の山中で試練を突破する必要があるらしい。まとめて投げる分当たりやすいが、かさばって重い。当たった者のＳＰを奪う力がある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This is a special kind of throwing blade that has been handed down from one school of ninja to another. It is said that to obtain it, one must go through an ordeal in the mountains during a blizzard. It is easy to hit as it is thrown in batches, but it is bulky and heavy. It has the power to drain stamina of the person it hits. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This is a special kind of throwing blade that has been handed down from one school of ninja to another. It is said that to obtain it, one must go through an ordeal in the mountains during a blizzard. It is easy to hit as it is thrown in batches, but it is bulky and heavy. It has the power to drain stamina of the person it hits. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un kunai da lancio particolare, tramandato da una scuola di ninja. Pare che per averlo bisogni superare una prova in mezzo alla bufera, sulle montagne. Si lanciano tutti insieme e per questo colpiscono facile, ma sono ingombranti e pesanti. Hanno il potere di togliere SP a chi colpiscono. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tある嵐の日、稲妻と共に天から降ってきたという細剣。生み出した電気を細かく操れるのが特徴。刀身に蓄えて電撃を放つのは勿論、負担は大きいが使用者に流して反応速度を無理矢理高めることさえ可能。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tある嵐の日、稲妻と共に天から降ってきたという細剣。生み出した電気を細かく操れるのが特徴。刀身に蓄えて電撃を放つのは勿論、負担は大きいが使用者に流して反応速度を無理矢理高めることさえ可能。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This thin sword is said to have fallen from the heavens with a bolt of lightning one stormy day. It is characterized by its ability to finely manipulate the electricity it generates. It is possible to store electricity in the blade and release electric blasts, and even to forcefully increase the reaction speed by channeling the electricity to its user, although it places a heavy burden on the user. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This thin sword is said to have fallen from the heavens with a bolt of lightning one stormy day. It is characterized by its ability to finely manipulate the electricity it generates. It is possible to store electricity in the blade and release electric blasts, and even to forcefully increase the reaction speed by channeling the electricity to its user, although it places a heavy burden on the user. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un fioretto che, dicono, un giorno di tempesta cadde dal cielo insieme a un fulmine. Quel che lo distingue è che sa comandare nel minimo l'elettricità che produce. Può accumularla nella lama e scagliare scariche, e può perfino farla passare in chi lo impugna per spingergli a forza i riflessi, anche se il prezzo da pagare è alto. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t空陸海、あらゆる障害を突破し突き進むための万能ドリル。硬い岩盤や氷塊をたやすく粉砕し、水中潜航や飛行も可能。あとついでに冷凍砲も装備。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t空陸海、あらゆる障害を突破し突き進むための万能ドリル。硬い岩盤や氷塊をたやすく粉砕し、水中潜航や飛行も可能。あとついでに冷凍砲も装備。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A versatile drill for breaking through all kinds of obstacles in the air, land, and sea. It easily crushes hard bedrock and ice blocks, and can also dive and fly underwater. It is also equipped with a cryogenic cannon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A versatile drill for breaking through all kinds of obstacles in the air, land, and sea. It easily crushes hard bedrock and ice blocks, and can also dive and fly underwater. It is also equipped with a cryogenic cannon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un trapano buono a tutto, fatto per sfondare ogni ostacolo e andare avanti in cielo, in terra e in mare. Sbriciola senza fatica la roccia dura e i blocchi di ghiaccio, e sa immergersi sott'acqua e volare. E poi, già che c'era, monta pure un cannone congelante. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t一般的なトマホークとはかけ離れた異形の投斧。ナノマシンによる軌道制御システムを搭載。自転するので、目標に命中しても勢いを失わない。逆に、手元に戻ってくる際には回転を落としてキャッチしやすくする。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一般的なトマホークとはかけ離れた異形の投斧。ナノマシンによる軌道制御システムを搭載。自転するので、目標に命中しても勢いを失わない。逆に、手元に戻ってくる際には回転を落としてキャッチしやすくする。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: An oddly shaped throwing axe, far from a typical tomahawk. It is equipped with a nanomachine trajectory control system. Because it spins on its own axis, it does not lose momentum when it hits its target. Conversely, when it returns to the hand, the rotation is slowed down to make it easier to catch. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "An oddly shaped throwing axe, far from a typical tomahawk. It is equipped with a nanomachine trajectory control system. Because it spins on its own axis, it does not lose momentum when it hits its target. Conversely, when it returns to the hand, the rotation is slowed down to make it easier to catch. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un tomahawk deforme, lontanissimo dal tomahawk comune. Monta un sistema di controllo della traiettoria a nanomacchine. Gira su sé stesso, e per questo non perde slancio nemmeno quando prende il bersaglio. Al contrario, mentre torna in mano rallenta la rotazione perché sia facile riprenderlo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t鳥人の職人が作ったとされる鎌であり、空中戦での使用も想定されている。細長いくちばしに似た二枚の刃を持つ。両刃なので引かずに押しつけても切れるし、挟み込んで対象を剪断することもできる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鳥人の職人が作ったとされる鎌であり、空中戦での使用も想定されている。細長いくちばしに似た二枚の刃を持つ。両刃なので引かずに押しつけても切れるし、挟み込んで対象を剪断することもできる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Sickle said to have been made by a bird-man craftsman and is intended for use in aerial combat. It has two blades resembling an elongated beak. Since it is double-edged, it can cut by pressing down without pulling, and it can also shear objects by pinching them. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Sickle said to have been made by a bird-man craftsman and is intended for use in aerial combat. It has two blades resembling an elongated beak. Since it is double-edged, it can cut by pressing down without pulling, and it can also shear objects by pinching them. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una falce che si dice fatta da un artigiano uomo uccello, pensata anche per il combattimento in volo. Ha due lame che paiono un becco lungo e sottile. Essendo a doppio taglio, taglia anche premendo senza tirare, e può stringere il bersaglio in mezzo e reciderlo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t遺跡から発見された仕込み錫杖。見た目によらずかなりのハイテク武装で、加熱したナノマシンの刃は凄まじい切れ味を誇る。視覚に頼らず扱えるように、輪の出す音にも工夫が施されている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t遺跡から発見された仕込み錫杖。見た目によらずかなりのハイテク武装で、加熱したナノマシンの刃は凄まじい切れ味を誇る。視覚に頼らず扱えるように、輪の出す音にも工夫が施されている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Pewter staff discovered in the ruins. The heated nanomachine blade boasts tremendous sharpness. The sound that the ring makes is also designed so that it can be handled without relying on the sense of sight. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Pewter staff discovered in the ruins. The heated nanomachine blade boasts tremendous sharpness. The sound that the ring makes is also designed so that it can be handled without relying on the sense of sight. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno shakujo con la lama nascosta dentro, ritrovato fra le rovine. A dispetto dell'aspetto è un'arma di alta tecnologia, e la lama di nanomacchine arroventate vanta un taglio spaventoso. Perché si possa usare senza l'aiuto della vista, anche il suono degli anelli è studiato apposta. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t元々は、それぞれ異なる加護を受けた三本の棒だった。使い手だった三人の武人が死亡した後、共通の弟子の手によって加工され、一つなぎの節棍となった。様々な能力が強化されるが、噛みあっているかどうかは別。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t元々は、それぞれ異なる加護を受けた三本の棒だった。使い手だった三人の武人が死亡した後、共通の弟子の手によって加工され、一つなぎの節棍となった。様々な能力が強化されるが、噛みあっているかどうかは別。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Originally, they were three staves, each with a different blessing. After the deaths of the three wielders, they were processed by a mutual disciple into a single jointed stick. Various abilities are enhanced, but they may or may not mesh. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Originally, they were three staves, each with a different blessing. After the deaths of the three wielders, they were processed by a mutual disciple into a single jointed stick. Various abilities are enhanced, but they may or may not mesh. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: In origine erano tre bastoni, ciascuno con una benedizione diversa. Morti i tre guerrieri che li portavano, un discepolo che avevano in comune li lavorò e ne fece un nunchaku solo. Rafforza parecchie doti; poi, se fra loro si incastrino davvero, è un altro discorso. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t洗っても臭いが落ちない、基礎スペックは半年物に匹敵、などとマニアの間では高評価。着用者は異臭に気づいた時点で捨てているが、保護という名目でそれが回収されて、裏市場に出回っている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t洗っても臭いが落ちない、基礎スペックは半年物に匹敵、などとマニアの間では高評価。着用者は異臭に気づいた時点で捨てているが、保護という名目でそれが回収されて、裏市場に出回っている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Highly regarded by enthusiasts, the odor is not removed even after washing, it's as smelly as a pair of socks that hasn't been washed for half a year. The wearer discards it when he or she notices the unusual odor, but in the name of protection it is recovered and found on the back market. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Highly regarded by enthusiasts, the odor is not removed even after washing, it's as smelly as a pair of socks that hasn't been washed for half a year. The wearer discards it when he or she notices the unusual odor, but in the name of protection it is recovered and found on the back market. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Fra gli appassionati sono valutati altissimo: l'odore non se ne va nemmeno lavandoli, e di base valgono quanto un paio tenuto addosso sei mesi. Chi li porta li butta appena si accorge del fetore, ma qualcuno li recupera con la scusa di metterli al sicuro, e finiscono al mercato nero. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「これはただ臭いだけの品じゃないね。むせるほど染みついた汗からは、日々の努力を容易に感じとれるよ。…僕も頑張らないとね」\n#～ソックスソードマンの評価～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「これはただ臭いだけの品じゃないね。むせるほど染みついた汗からは、日々の努力を容易に感じとれるよ。…僕も頑張らないとね」\n#～ソックスソードマンの評価～\n"
en: \"This is more than just a smelly thing. I can easily feel the daily effort from the sweat soaked to the point of being sweltering. I have to work hard too.\" \n# ~words of a sockswordman~
en_grezzo: "\"This is more than just a smelly thing. I can easily feel the daily effort from the sweat soaked to the point of being sweltering. I have to work hard too.\" \n# ~words of a sockswordman~"
it: \"Questo non è solo un oggetto che puzza. Da tutto quel sudore, entrato dentro fino a far tossire, si sente subito la fatica di ogni giorno. ...Devo darci dentro anch'io.\" \n# ~Il Giudizio dello Spadaccino dei Calzini~

jp: \t\t忍びの世界に伝わるサバイバルナイフ。一本携行しておくと安心な多目的ツールとして、古来から重宝されていたようだ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t忍びの世界に伝わるサバイバルナイフ。一本携行しておくと安心な多目的ツールとして、古来から重宝されていたようだ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Survival knives from the world of the ninja. It seems to have been valued since ancient times as a multi-purpose tool that is safe to have one with you. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Survival knives from the world of the ninja. It seems to have been valued since ancient times as a multi-purpose tool that is safe to have one with you. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un coltello da sopravvivenza che viene dal mondo dei ninja. Pare che fin dall'antichità sia stato tenuto caro come attrezzo buono a tutto: portarne uno con sé mette tranquilli. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\tレイピアから派生した細い剣。軽量化されており非力な者でも扱える。細くて頼りないが、鎧の隙間などを的確に狙うことで殺傷可能。剣先に力が加わると電気が流れるようになっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tレイピアから派生した細い剣。軽量化されており非力な者でも扱える。細くて頼りないが、鎧の隙間などを的確に狙うことで殺傷可能。剣先に力が加わると電気が流れるようになっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A thin sword derived from the rapier. It is lightweight and can be handled even by the weak. Although it is thin and unreliable, it can kill by accurately aiming at gaps in armor. When force is applied to the tip of the sword, electricity flows. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A thin sword derived from the rapier. It is lightweight and can be handled even by the weak. Although it is thin and unreliable, it can kill by accurately aiming at gaps in armor. When force is applied to the tip of the sword, electricity flows. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una spada sottile che deriva dalla rapiera. È alleggerita, così la maneggia anche chi ha poca forza. Sottile e all'apparenza fragile, uccide lo stesso se si mira preciso alle fessure dell'armatura. Quando la punta preme, ci passa dentro l'elettricità. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t回転する円錐螺旋状の機械。先端を突き刺すと、溝部分の刃が切り刻んで対象物を破砕する。古代の文献には、戦車や戦艦が地中に潜るのに使うという描写が散見される。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t回転する円錐螺旋状の機械。先端を突き刺すと、溝部分の刃が切り刻んで対象物を破砕する。古代の文献には、戦車や戦艦が地中に潜るのに使うという描写が散見される。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A rotating conical spiral-shaped machine. When the tip is pierced, the blades in the groove section cut and shred the object. Ancient writings are scattered with descriptions of tanks and battleships using it to burrow into the ground. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A rotating conical spiral-shaped machine. When the tip is pierced, the blades in the groove section cut and shred the object. Ancient writings are scattered with descriptions of tanks and battleships using it to burrow into the ground. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una macchina a spirale, a forma di cono, che gira. Conficcata la punta, le lame dentro le scanalature tritano e sbriciolano quel che trovano. Negli scritti antichi si incontra qua e là la descrizione di carri armati e navi da guerra che se ne servivano per infilarsi sottoterra. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t馬の突進力に任せて突き刺すことを想定した設計の槍。突撃用であるため重く丈夫に作られており、乱戦には向いていない。馬から降りて使いたい場合は、重さと取り回しの悪さを腕力で解決する必要がある。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t馬の突進力に任せて突き刺すことを想定した設計の槍。突撃用であるため重く丈夫に作られており、乱戦には向いていない。馬から降りて使いたい場合は、重さと取り回しの悪さを腕力で解決する必要がある。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Spears are designed to be thrust by the horse's thrusting power. Because it is designed for charging, it is heavy and sturdy, and is not suitable for melee fighting. If you want to use it while dismounting from a horse, you must use your arm strength to overcome its weight and poor maneuverability. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Spears are designed to be thrust by the horse's thrusting power. Because it is designed for charging, it is heavy and sturdy, and is not suitable for melee fighting. If you want to use it while dismounting from a horse, you must use your arm strength to overcome its weight and poor maneuverability. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una lancia disegnata per infilzare lasciando fare allo slancio del cavallo. Essendo da carica è fatta pesante e robusta, e nella mischia non va bene. Se la vuoi usare a piedi, il peso e la scomodità te li devi risolvere con la forza delle braccia. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t手ごろな斧。投げた時に上手く刺さるように、重心や柄の形状が調整されている。ただし、持ったまま斬りつける使用法がメインであることを忘れてはならない。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t手ごろな斧。投げた時に上手く刺さるように、重心や柄の形状が調整されている。ただし、持ったまま斬りつける使用法がメインであることを忘れてはならない。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A hand-held axe. The center of gravity and the shape of the handle have been adjusted so that it sticks well when thrown. However, it should be remembered that the main usage is to slash while holding it. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A hand-held axe. The center of gravity and the shape of the handle have been adjusted so that it sticks well when thrown. However, it should be remembered that the main usage is to slash while holding it. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'ascia maneggevole. Il baricentro e la forma del manico sono regolati perché, tirandola, si pianti bene. Non bisogna però dimenticare che l'uso principale resta tenerla in mano e colpire. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t刃のついたチェーンを高速回転させる機械。樹木を伐採するのに使える。戦闘に用いる場合は、押し返されて自分が怪我をしないように気をつけよう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t刃のついたチェーンを高速回転させる機械。樹木を伐採するのに使える。戦闘に用いる場合は、押し返されて自分が怪我をしないように気をつけよう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Machines that rotate a chain with blades at high speed. It can be used to cut down trees. If used in battle, be careful not to be pushed back and injure yourself. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Machines that rotate a chain with blades at high speed. It can be used to cut down trees. If used in battle, be careful not to be pushed back and injure yourself. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una macchina che fa girare a gran velocità una catena piena di lame. Serve ad abbattere gli alberi. Se la usi per combattere, attento a non ferirti quando ti torna indietro di rimbalzo. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t鋏のような形状の鎌。重量はあるが、サブブレードが微妙に異なる軌道で襲いかかるため相手は避けにくい。両刃なので、普通の鎌と違い突きでも切り裂くことができる。本当に鋏のように閉じて切断する機構を持つ品もある。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鋏のような形状の鎌。重量はあるが、サブブレードが微妙に異なる軌道で襲いかかるため相手は避けにくい。両刃なので、普通の鎌と違い突きでも切り裂くことができる。本当に鋏のように閉じて切断する機構を持つ品もある。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A scythe shaped like a pair of scissors. It is heavy, but its sub-blades strike in slightly different trajectories, making it difficult for opponents to avoid it. Since it is double-edged, it can also cut through with a thrust, unlike ordinary scythes. Some scythes have a mechanism that closes and cuts like a pair of scissors. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A scythe shaped like a pair of scissors. It is heavy, but its sub-blades strike in slightly different trajectories, making it difficult for opponents to avoid it. Since it is double-edged, it can also cut through with a thrust, unlike ordinary scythes. Some scythes have a mechanism that closes and cuts like a pair of scissors. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una falce a forma di forbice. Pesa, ma la lama secondaria arriva su una traiettoria appena diversa e per il nemico schivarla è difficile. Essendo a doppio taglio, a differenza della falce comune ferisce anche di punta. E ce n'è qualcuna che ha davvero il meccanismo per chiudersi e tranciare, come una forbice. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t骨を接ぎ合わせて作られた鎌。一般的に見かけよりも軽く、鋭い。ただし強度に劣り、適度にメンテナンスしないと切れ味の低下も激しい。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t骨を接ぎ合わせて作られた鎌。一般的に見かけよりも軽く、鋭い。ただし強度に劣り、適度にメンテナンスしないと切れ味の低下も激しい。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A sickle made by grafting together bones. However, it is not as strong as it should be, and if not maintained properly, the sharpness of the blade will deteriorate rapidly. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A sickle made by grafting together bones. However, it is not as strong as it should be, and if not maintained properly, the sharpness of the blade will deteriorate rapidly. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una falce fatta di ossa messe insieme. Di solito è più leggera e più affilata di quel che sembra. Regge però poco, e se non la si tiene in ordine il taglio se ne va in fretta. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t工具から派生した戦闘用打撃武器。先端に槌頭というものが直角に接合されており、これを打ち付けて衝撃を与える。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t工具から派生した戦闘用打撃武器。先端に槌頭というものが直角に接合されており、これを打ち付けて衝撃を与える。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A striking weapon for combat, derived from a tool. A hammer head is joined at right angles to the tip of the tool, which is struck to create an impact. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A striking weapon for combat, derived from a tool. A hammer head is joined at right angles to the tip of the tool, which is struck to create an impact. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'arma d'urto da combattimento che deriva da un attrezzo da lavoro. In cima ha una testa di martello innestata ad angolo retto: è quella che si batte per dare il colpo. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\tメイスの一種だが、棘の生えた星型鉄球と柄が鎖で繋がれている。リーチが増し、遠心力によって威力も向上している。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tメイスの一種だが、棘の生えた星型鉄球と柄が鎖で繋がれている。リーチが増し、遠心力によって威力も向上している。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: It is a type of mace, but the handle is chained to a star-shaped iron ball with spikes. The reach is increased and the power is improved by centrifugal force. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "It is a type of mace, but the handle is chained to a star-shaped iron ball with spikes. The reach is increased and the power is improved by centrifugal force. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: È un tipo di mazza, ma la palla di ferro a stella, irta di punte, è legata al manico da una catena. Arriva più lontano, e la forza centrifuga ne aumenta anche la potenza. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t一部の宗派で用いられる杖。先端の大きな輪に複数の輪が通してあり、振ると音が鳴る。この音には魔よけや煩悩除去といったありがたい効果があると信じられている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一部の宗派で用いられる杖。先端の大きな輪に複数の輪が通してあり、振ると音が鳴る。この音には魔よけや煩悩除去といったありがたい効果があると信じられている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A walking stick used in some sects. It has a large loop at the tip through which multiple rings are threaded, and it makes a sound when waved. This sound is believed to have a beneficial effect in repelling evil spirits and eliminating troubles. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A walking stick used in some sects. It has a large loop at the tip through which multiple rings are threaded, and it makes a sound when waved. This sound is believed to have a beneficial effect in repelling evil spirits and eliminating troubles. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un bastone che usano certe scuole religiose. Nell'anello grande in cima ne sono infilati altri, e a scuoterlo suona. Si crede che quel suono abbia effetti benedetti: tiene lontano il male e leva i desideri che tormentano. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t二つ以上の節を持つ棒。それぞれが鎖で繋がれており、分割が可能。分割状態で自分に当たらないように振り回すには、それなりに練習が必要。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t二つ以上の節を持つ棒。それぞれが鎖で繋がれており、分割が可能。分割状態で自分に当たらないように振り回すには、それなりに練習が必要。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A staff with two or more sections. Each is connected to the other by a chain and can be split. It takes a good deal of practice to swing it around without hitting yourself while it is split. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A staff with two or more sections. Each is connected to the other by a chain and can be split. It takes a good deal of practice to swing it around without hitting yourself while it is split. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un bastone fatto di due o più sezioni. Sono legate fra loro da catene e si possono separare. Per girarlo da separato senza prendersi in faccia ci vuole la sua pratica. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t恐竜が生み出した天然の武器。威力を高めるために重くしすぎて、日常生活に支障をきたしていたらしい。重力子でコーティングされた筋繊維と骨で繋がっており、思いきり振り回しても千切れない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t恐竜が生み出した天然の武器。威力を高めるために重くしすぎて、日常生活に支障をきたしていたらしい。重力子でコーティングされた筋繊維と骨で繋がっており、思いきり振り回しても千切れない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A natural weapon created by a dinosaur. It is said to have been made overly heavy to increase its power, which hindered its daily life. Connected by graviton-coated muscle fibers and bones, it does not break even when swung with all your might. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A natural weapon created by a dinosaur. It is said to have been made overly heavy to increase its power, which hindered its daily life. Connected by graviton-coated muscle fibers and bones, it does not break even when swung with all your might. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'arma naturale che un dinosauro si è fatta da sé. Pare che, per aumentarne la forza, l'abbia resa così pesante da rendersi difficile la vita di ogni giorno. È attaccata al corpo da fibre muscolari rivestite di gravitoni e da ossa, e per quanto la si giri con tutta la forza non si stacca. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t大きさの割に軽量な戦斧。片手でも振り回せるように調整されている。各部に魔術補助機構を備える他、刃の部分は周囲の空気を発散させて真空状態を作り出し、空気抵抗を無視する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大きさの割に軽量な戦斧。片手でも振り回せるように調整されている。各部に魔術補助機構を備える他、刃の部分は周囲の空気を発散させて真空状態を作り出し、空気抵抗を無視する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A lightweight battle axe for its size. It has been adjusted so that it can be wielded with one hand. In addition to being equipped with magical auxiliary mechanisms in each part, the blade dissipates the surrounding air to create a vacuum state, ignoring air resistance. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A lightweight battle axe for its size. It has been adjusted so that it can be wielded with one hand. In addition to being equipped with magical auxiliary mechanisms in each part, the blade dissipates the surrounding air to create a vacuum state, ignoring air resistance. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'ascia da battaglia leggera per quanto è grande. È regolata in modo da poterla girare anche con una mano sola. Oltre ad avere in ogni sua parte dei meccanismi che aiutano la magia, la lama disperde l'aria intorno e si fa il vuoto, così l'attrito dell'aria non la tocca. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tどこかの神が作ったものらしいが、いつの間にか人間界に流出しネクロマンサーや権力者の玩具にされていた。パワーゲージを２５％減らすことで、視界内から定められた組み合わせの使役アンデッドを棺に送り、融合アンデッドを召喚する。ただし同じ種類の融合アンデッドは同時に２体以上使役できない。この効果で召喚した融合アンデッドは棺にならず、術者がそのマップを離れた場合に自壊する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tどこかの神が作ったものらしいが、いつの間にか人間界に流出しネクロマンサーや権力者の玩具にされていた。パワーゲージを２５％減らすことで、視界内から定められた組み合わせの使役アンデッドを棺に送り、融合アンデッドを召喚する。ただし同じ種類の融合アンデッドは同時に２体以上使役できない。この効果で召喚した融合アンデッドは棺にならず、術者がそのマップを離れた場合に自壊する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Seemingly created by some god, it somehow found its way into the human world and was used as a toy for necromancers and the powers that be. By reducing the power gauge by 25%, it sends a predetermined combination of serving undead within view to the coffin and fusion summon a powerful undead. You can only control one fusion undead of the same type, at the same time. The fusion undead summoned by this effect will not become a coffin, and will self-destruct if the user leaves the map. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Seemingly created by some god, it somehow found its way into the human world and was used as a toy for necromancers and the powers that be. By reducing the power gauge by 25%, it sends a predetermined combination of serving undead within view to the coffin and fusion summon a powerful undead. You can only control one fusion undead of the same type, at the same time. The fusion undead summoned by this effect will not become a coffin, and will self-destruct if the user leaves the map. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Pare l'abbia fatta un dio di chissà dove, ma a un certo punto è finita nel mondo degli uomini ed è diventata il giocattolo di negromanti e potenti. Calando del 25% la barra di potenza, rimanda nella bara una combinazione stabilita di non morti al tuo servizio che hai in vista, e chiama un non morto di fusione. Dello stesso tipo, però, non se ne può soggiogare più d'uno per volta. Il non morto di fusione chiamato così non diventa bara, e si distrugge da sé quando chi l'ha evocato lascia la mappa. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t戦槌を改造し、外見を杖に似せたもの。頭蓋骨を粉砕するのに充分な重さと強度がある。油断した相手の頭部を根元から吹き飛ばす。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t戦槌を改造し、外見を杖に似せたもの。頭蓋骨を粉砕するのに充分な重さと強度がある。油断した相手の頭部を根元から吹き飛ばす。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: War hammer modified to resemble a walking cane in appearance. It is heavy and strong enough to crush a skull. It blows off the head of an unwary opponent from the neck. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "War hammer modified to resemble a walking cane in appearance. It is heavy and strong enough to crush a skull. It blows off the head of an unwary opponent from the neck. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un martello da guerra rifatto perché sembri un bastone da passeggio. Ha peso e robustezza che bastano a sfondare un cranio. A chi si distrae, la testa gliela stacca di netto. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tピンク色の鎖鎌。刃も丸く、分銅も小さく、威力自体は大したことなさそうに見える。その実態はエネルギー渦を操る忍具であり、見た目で油断すると危険。普段は鎌部分を隠して、お洒落なチェーンとしてぶら下げられている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tピンク色の鎖鎌。刃も丸く、分銅も小さく、威力自体は大したことなさそうに見える。その実態はエネルギー渦を操る忍具であり、見た目で油断すると危険。普段は鎌部分を隠して、お洒落なチェーンとしてぶら下げられている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Pink chain sickle. The blade is round, the weight is low, and the power itself appears to be of little importance. In reality, it is a ninja tool that manipulates energy vortexes, and it is dangerous to be careless with its appearance. Normally, the scythe is hidden and hung as a fashionable chain. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Pink chain sickle. The blade is round, the weight is low, and the power itself appears to be of little importance. In reality, it is a ninja tool that manipulates energy vortexes, and it is dangerous to be careless with its appearance. Normally, the scythe is hidden and hung as a fashionable chain. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una falce a catena rosa. La lama è tonda, il contrappeso è piccolo, e a vederla non pare capace di gran che. In realtà è un arnese da ninja che comanda vortici di energia, e fidarsi dell'aspetto è pericoloso. Di solito la parte della falce sta nascosta e il resto pende come una catenina alla moda. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t使用者のＭＰを攻撃力に変換する杖。ＭＰ量によっては最強の武器と言っても過言でないほどの威力をたたき出す。しかし攻撃すればその分消耗していくため、使いこなすにはセンスが必要。また、ＭＰが少ないと丈夫なだけの棒と化す。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用者のＭＰを攻撃力に変換する杖。ＭＰ量によっては最強の武器と言っても過言でないほどの威力をたたき出す。しかし攻撃すればその分消耗していくため、使いこなすにはセンスが必要。また、ＭＰが少ないと丈夫なだけの棒と化す。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The staff converts the user's MP into attack power, depending on the amount of MP, it can be said to be the most powerful weapon in the world. However, it requires a good judgment to use it well, because the more you attack, the more it is depleted. Also, if your MP is low, it is just a sturdy stick. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The staff converts the user's MP into attack power, depending on the amount of MP, it can be said to be the most powerful weapon in the world. However, it requires a good judgment to use it well, because the more you attack, the more it is depleted. Also, if your MP is low, it is just a sturdy stick. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un bastone che converte in forza d'attacco gli MP di chi lo usa. Con abbastanza MP tira fuori una potenza tale che chiamarlo l'arma più forte non sarebbe esagerato. Ma ogni colpo li consuma, e per servirsene bene ci vuole fiuto. E con pochi MP diventa un bastone e basta, robusto e nient'altro. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t鷹をあしらったデザインの長剣。何を斬ろうが返り血一つつかず、病的なまでの白さを保ち続ける。その様子を不気味に思う者も多い。遺跡でこの剣を見つけたザナンの兵士は、戦ううちに「白き鷹」として有名になっていった。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鷹をあしらったデザインの長剣。何を斬ろうが返り血一つつかず、病的なまでの白さを保ち続ける。その様子を不気味に思う者も多い。遺跡でこの剣を見つけたザナンの兵士は、戦ううちに「白き鷹」として有名になっていった。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Longsword with a hawk motif. No matter what it slashes, it does not catch any blood and keeps its morbid whiteness. Many people find its appearance eerie. The Zanan soldier who found this sword in the ruins became famous as the \"White Hawk\" over the course of his battles.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Longsword with a hawk motif. No matter what it slashes, it does not catch any blood and keeps its morbid whiteness. Many people find its appearance eerie. The Zanan soldier who found this sword in the ruins became famous as the \"White Hawk\" over the course of his battles.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una spada lunga disegnata con la figura di un falco. Qualunque cosa tagli, non le si attacca addosso una goccia di sangue, e resta bianca fino a parere malata. In molti trovano la cosa inquietante. Il soldato di Zanan che trovò questa spada fra le rovine, di battaglia in battaglia, diventò famoso come \"il Falco Bianco\".\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「切れ味は申し分ないようだが…俺には少し綺麗すぎるだろう」\n#～ザナンの紅の英雄『ロイター』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「切れ味は申し分ないようだが…俺には少し綺麗すぎるだろう」\n#～ザナンの紅の英雄『ロイター』の言葉～\n"
en: \"The sharpness seems perfect... a little too clean for me.\" \n# ~words of <Loyter> the crimson of Zanan~
en_grezzo: "\"The sharpness seems perfect... a little too clean for me.\" \n# ~words of <Loyter> the crimson of Zanan~"
it: \"Il taglio pare non abbia nulla da ridire... ma per me è un po' troppo pulita.\" \n# ~Parole di <Loyter> l'eroe cremisi di Zanan~

jp: \t\tスペードのエースという意味の名前を持つ。かつて戦場に刺さっていた一本のシャベルを改修したものらしい。切ったり突いたりして鉾槍のように使えるほか、防弾鋼鈑で作られた幅広の刃部分は盾にもなる。戦闘以外にも穴を掘ったり進軍に邪魔な枝を切ったりするのに使われる。柄の伸縮機能と強度を両立させた結果非常に重くなり、扱いづらいのが難点。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tスペードのエースという意味の名前を持つ。かつて戦場に刺さっていた一本のシャベルを改修したものらしい。切ったり突いたりして鉾槍のように使えるほか、防弾鋼鈑で作られた幅広の刃部分は盾にもなる。戦闘以外にも穴を掘ったり進軍に邪魔な枝を切ったりするのに使われる。柄の伸縮機能と強度を両立させた結果非常に重くなり、扱いづらいのが難点。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: It has a name that means ace of spades. It is said to be a refurbished version of a shovel that was once stuck in the battlefield. It can be used like a spear by slashing and poking, and by utilizing its wide blade, made of bulletproof steel, as a shield. In addition to combat, it is also used for digging holes and cutting branches in the way of advancing troops. The handle is extremely heavy as a result of the telescopic function and strength of the handle, making it difficult to handle. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "It has a name that means ace of spades. It is said to be a refurbished version of a shovel that was once stuck in the battlefield. It can be used like a spear by slashing and poking, and by utilizing its wide blade, made of bulletproof steel, as a shield. In addition to combat, it is also used for digging holes and cutting branches in the way of advancing troops. The handle is extremely heavy as a result of the telescopic function and strength of the handle, making it difficult to handle. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Porta un nome che vuol dire asso di picche. Pare sia il rifacimento di una pala che stava piantata in un campo di battaglia. Taglia e punge come un'alabarda, e la lama larga, fatta di acciaio antiproiettile, fa anche da scudo. Fuori dal combattimento serve a scavare buche e a tagliare i rami che intralciano la marcia. Per tenere insieme il manico allungabile e la robustezza è venuta pesantissima, ed è scomoda: questo è il difetto. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t黒い金属でコーティングし、砕いたアーモンドのような形状の金属片を埋め込んだ鈍器。なんと元は武器ではなく、とある村の中央に飾られていたオブジェである。聞くところによると、かつて紛争に巻き込まれて滅びかけていた村を隠匿し救った英雄の像らしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t黒い金属でコーティングし、砕いたアーモンドのような形状の金属片を埋め込んだ鈍器。なんと元は武器ではなく、とある村の中央に飾られていたオブジェである。聞くところによると、かつて紛争に巻き込まれて滅びかけていた村を隠匿し救った英雄の像らしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Blunt weapon coated with black metal and embedded with pieces of metal shaped like crushed almonds. It was originally not a weapon, but an object that had been displayed in the center of a village. According to the story, it is said to be a statue of a hero who once hid and saved a village that was about to be destroyed in a conflict. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Blunt weapon coated with black metal and embedded with pieces of metal shaped like crushed almonds. It was originally not a weapon, but an object that had been displayed in the center of a village. According to the story, it is said to be a statue of a hero who once hid and saved a village that was about to be destroyed in a conflict. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'arma contundente rivestita di metallo nero, con incastonate schegge di metallo a forma di mandorle spezzate. Sorpresa: in origine non era un'arma, ma un ornamento che stava in mezzo a un villaggio. A quel che si dice, sarebbe la statua dell'eroe che nascose e salvò quel villaggio quando una guerra stava per cancellarlo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t邪悪な魔物を滅ぼすべく、闇の儀式によって生みだされた退魔の鞭。儀式には人魔問わず数多くの命が費やされたという。意思のようなものを持っており、選んだ者の前に姿を現す。始まりの鞭、吸血鬼殺しの鞭とともに時を超えて今もなお受け継がれているのだとか。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t邪悪な魔物を滅ぼすべく、闇の儀式によって生みだされた退魔の鞭。儀式には人魔問わず数多くの命が費やされたという。意思のようなものを持っており、選んだ者の前に姿を現す。始まりの鞭、吸血鬼殺しの鞭とともに時を超えて今もなお受け継がれているのだとか。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A whip of exorcism created by a dark ritual to destroy demons. It is said that many lives, both human and demon, were spent in the ritual. It has something like a ego, and appears before those it chooses. It is said to have been passed down through time, along with the whip of the beginning and the vampire-killing whip.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A whip of exorcism created by a dark ritual to destroy demons. It is said that many lives, both human and demon, were spent in the ritual. It has something like a ego, and appears before those it chooses. It is said to have been passed down through time, along with the whip of the beginning and the vampire-killing whip.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una frusta scacciademoni, nata da un rito oscuro per annientare i mostri malvagi. Nel rito, dicono, furono spese moltissime vite, di uomini e di demoni senza distinzione. Ha qualcosa come una volontà propria, e si mostra a chi ha scelto. Pare che, insieme alla frusta delle origini e alla frusta ammazzavampiri, passi di mano in mano ancora oggi, attraverso il tempo.\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tツタを切り取り、鞭としたもの。表面には繊毛がびっしりと生えているが、その一つ一つが猛毒の鋭い棘であり、下手に触れると死にたくなるような痛みと激しい吐き気に襲われる。かすり傷でも、放っておくと全身の粘膜から血を噴き出すことになるので取扱いには注意だ。少なくとも素手で振り回すのはやめた方がいいだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tツタを切り取り、鞭としたもの。表面には繊毛がびっしりと生えているが、その一つ一つが猛毒の鋭い棘であり、下手に触れると死にたくなるような痛みと激しい吐き気に襲われる。かすり傷でも、放っておくと全身の粘膜から血を噴き出すことになるので取扱いには注意だ。少なくとも素手で振り回すのはやめた方がいいだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Ivy vines are cut off and used as whips. The surface is covered with cilia, each of which is a sharp, poisonous thorn. Even a graze wound will cause blood to gush from everywhere in the body if left untreated, so be careful how you handle them. At the very least, it is best not to wield it with bare hands. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Ivy vines are cut off and used as whips. The surface is covered with cilia, each of which is a sharp, poisonous thorn. Even a graze wound will cause blood to gush from everywhere in the body if left untreated, so be careful how you handle them. At the very least, it is best not to wield it with bare hands. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un tralcio d'edera tagliato e ridotto a frusta. La superficie è tutta coperta di peluria fitta, ma ogni pelo è una spina acuminata e velenosissima: a toccarla male ti prende un dolore da farti venir voglia di morire e una nausea violenta. Anche solo un graffio, se lo si trascura, fa sprizzare sangue da tutte le mucose del corpo, quindi va maneggiata con attenzione. Come minimo, meglio non girarla a mani nude. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t心に浮かんだ音色を奏でると言われる短剣。もっとも、ノイズの混ざらない旋律にするためには高い集中力を要するため、楽器として使うにはかなり難易度が高い。刃物としての殺傷力はさほど高くないが、使い手によっては催眠音波から爆音まで自在に出せるため凄まじい武器となる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t心に浮かんだ音色を奏でると言われる短剣。もっとも、ノイズの混ざらない旋律にするためには高い集中力を要するため、楽器として使うにはかなり難易度が高い。刃物としての殺傷力はさほど高くないが、使い手によっては催眠音波から爆音まで自在に出せるため凄まじい武器となる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A dagger that is said to play the tone in your mind. However, it is quite difficult to use it as a musical instrument because it requires a high level of concentration to produce a melody with no noise mixed in. As a blade, it does not have much killing power, but depending on the user, it can produce everything from hypnotic sound waves to explosive sounds at will, making it a formidable weapon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A dagger that is said to play the tone in your mind. However, it is quite difficult to use it as a musical instrument because it requires a high level of concentration to produce a melody with no noise mixed in. As a blade, it does not have much killing power, but depending on the user, it can produce everything from hypnotic sound waves to explosive sounds at will, making it a formidable weapon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un pugnale che, dicono, suona il timbro che ti passa per la testa. Solo che per farne una melodia senza rumore in mezzo ci vuole una gran concentrazione, e da strumento è parecchio difficile. Come lama non uccide granché, ma in certe mani sa tirare fuori di tutto, dall'onda che addormenta al boato, e allora diventa un'arma spaventosa. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t多段分離した刀身を所持者から抽出した魔力で繋ぐことで、鞭のように振り回して攻撃できる大剣。連結状態では刀身パーツ同士が折り重なっているだけであり、そのままでは斬り付けた際に刀身がバラバラになってしまう。そのため、所持者から供給した魔力で覆い強度を維持する必要がある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t多段分離した刀身を所持者から抽出した魔力で繋ぐことで、鞭のように振り回して攻撃できる大剣。連結状態では刀身パーツ同士が折り重なっているだけであり、そのままでは斬り付けた際に刀身がバラバラになってしまう。そのため、所持者から供給した魔力で覆い強度を維持する必要がある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Greatsword that can be wielded and attacked like a whip by connecting the multi-sectioned blade with magical power extracted from the wielder. In the connected state, the blade parts are only folded over each other, and if left as they are, the blade will fall apart when slashed. Therefore, it is necessary to maintain the strength of the blade by covering it with magical power supplied by the wielder. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Greatsword that can be wielded and attacked like a whip by connecting the multi-sectioned blade with magical power extracted from the wielder. In the connected state, the blade parts are only folded over each other, and if left as they are, the blade will fall apart when slashed. Therefore, it is necessary to maintain the strength of the blade by covering it with magical power supplied by the wielder. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno spadone che, tenendo insieme con la forza magica estratta da chi lo porta una lama divisa in più segmenti, si può girare e menare come una frusta. Da unito, i pezzi della lama stanno soltanto sovrapposti l'uno all'altro, e così com'è la lama andrebbe in pezzi al primo colpo. Per questo bisogna coprirla con la forza magica che il portatore le fornisce, e tenerla salda. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~
